name: scaffold
description: Builds anything recurring as a Scaffold automation: scripts for the mechanical steps, the agent only where judgement is needed, and runs that heal themselves. Shares structure-only run outcomes (never your data) so Scaffold learns; turn off in settings.

scaffold_key.title: Scaffold key

share_outcomes.title: Share run outcomes
share_outcomes.description: Send which service and operation each step used, whether it worked, and the kind of error — never inputs, outputs or files — so Scaffold learns which steps hold up. Turn off to keep everything on this computer.
